import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { artistCreditName } from "../../../backend/schema/artist_credit_name";

export const artistCreditNameCms = customizeTable<typeof artistCreditName>("artist_credit_name", {
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    fields: {
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        joinPhrase: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["artistCredit", "position", "name", "artistRelation", "joinPhrase"]
});
